notes: Torah #237 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=237. The packages file contains 1 package with 5 nodes (Levi, melody/musical instruments, hitḥabrut/joining, wedding instruments, wedding — all good polarity), derived from source text bechina analysis. All 5 nodes are already assigned to the bechina package. The Torah's core teaching is that melody (niggun) is the bechina of joining (hitḥabrut) — Levi brought melody to the world, and Leah said 'this time my husband will be joined to me' because melody enables the union of two things. Wedding instruments are the concrete expression of this principle. No causal chains appear in the text; the relationships are all parallel-nature (bechina). With zero eitza edges in the dataset, there are no nodes to assign.
